name: roest-v3-whisper-1.5b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence openrail, repo created 2026-01-11. CAVEATS: OpenRAIL licence (card tag openrail). Danish (CoRal-v3) only. The comparison column is the same table's openai/whisper-large-v3 row, zero-shot, same CoRal-v3 test splits.
